title: Robust Concept Erasure via Kernelized Rate-Distortion Maximization
benchmark_measurement: Erasure of vector-valued religious identity information from GPT-3.5 text representations, measured by the change in Mean Squared Error (MSE) and Generalized Demographic Parity (ΔGDP) on a downstream toxicity detection task.
findings: The proposed KRaM method effectively erased vector-valued religious identity concepts from GPT-3.5 text representations, achieving up to a 76% gain in Mean Squared Error (indicating successful erasure) over baselines while minimally impacting performance on the downstream toxicity detection task.
